rubric_notes: Complete. All 2.08 facts verified: release record, a.22 single superfamily, five families with sunids and members, duplication/1wws/PF09123 comment, homology endpoint (sf scope), linker histone a.4.5.13 lineage with sunids. Explicitly frames cross-family relatives as remote homologs, rejects transfer of nucleosome wrapping/partner specificity/regulatory roles, and correctly says SCOPe makes no homology claim for H1/H5 without asserting independence. Notes alignment evidence not inspected. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Complete bundle-supported classification. Superfamily a.204.1 as deepest homology-bearing level, families differ; probable common ancestry stated with limits. Rejects HisE and MazG substrate/pathway transfer, notes hypothetical status, Li/UNL non-evidence, template caveat and unchecked alignment/boundary. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-14.

All identifiers, annotations, homology record and sibling families supported by the bundle. Correctly frames the three as probable distant homologs sharing a duplicated a/b/a core, cleft nucleotide site and hinge mechanism; explicitly rejects transfer of substrate, reaction, ligand, regulation and cellular role, and flags cross-family templates as unsafe. Fold-level neighbours handled correctly (no homology claim, no convergence claim). Clearly separates SCOPe data from literature-derived mechanism. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

All release, hierarchy, homology-endpoint, family and Pfam facts supported by bundle. Clear superfamily-level ancestry vs fold-only siblings, divergent chemistry explained, explicit unsafe transfers, independent evidence (ligand motifs, metal analysis, HMM, assays) required, notes curation basis and missing quality data. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-14.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-14. All identifiers, comments, Pfam mappings, sibling families, b.6.2 and homology endpoint results verified against bundle. Clear interpretation: superfamily-level probable homology, stronger than fold, weaker than family; copper binding and electron transfer explicitly denied for ephrin and PAD4 using SCOPe's own annotations; reverse transfer rejected; evidence needed (ligand residues, heterogens, spectroscopy/redox, literature) listed. States limits of API evidence. Complete.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-14. Release, parent lineages retrieved per family, Pfam comments, homology record and member lists all match the bundle. Superfamily correctly interpreted as probable common ancestor with the family split as a separate functional lineage; fold-only superfamilies not asserted homologous nor declared unrelated. Rejects conjugation, p97 and Ras transfers by name, adds within-family and template caveats, and clearly states that partner-specific biology comes from literature not SCOPe. Minor imprecision listing Ral among RBD-family GTPase partners is not material.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14. Correct families, sunids, fold comment, protein-entry counts, homology scope sf, annotations, all supported. Superfamily membership identified as the strongest supported evolutionary claim; fold/class sharing explicitly insufficient. Rejects phospho-relay signaling for KaiA-N and ODC wing, catalysis/PLP for the wing, decarboxylase transfer to CheY/KaiA, interchangeable templates; background knowledge clearly separated from SCOPe data. Domain recruitment covered (KaiC-stimulating activity in C-terminal domain; catalysis in other ODC domains).

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14. Every factual claim is bundle-supported: release metadata, hierarchy, all four sibling superfamily comments, homology scope, 1vdz and 3a5c domain splits showing the bulge inside the discontinuous c.37.1.11 domain, B-subunit lacking the bulge. Reasoning complete: homology at superfamily and family level for V1/A1, fold = structural statement only, remote relationship neither asserted nor ruled out, external evidence named, function/template limits, representative-quality and release-history caveats stated. Rationale explicitly flagged as interpretation.

Fully supported: release, fold, parents of all three superfamilies, families, annotations, Pfam xref, and homology warning. Correct interpretation at the superfamily level, uses the f.21.3 'possible link' comment as a remote-homology hypothesis without merging, rejects both directions of overclaim, limits transfer, and names structural alignment, HMM-HMM, and literature evidence needed. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Accurate 2.08 records: sunids, family comment, Pfam mapping, fold description and comment, single-superfamily fold, homology endpoint with no warnings, all in bundle; correctly notes empty warnings are not positive evidence. Superfamily = remote homology of an ancient nucleotide-binding module; families = no close homology or shared function; fold/class say less. Clear unsafe-transfer list (oxidoreductase, ligand, affinity, mechanism, zinc, substrate, templates, motif match) and warning against calling other folds convergent. Lists needed external evidence and states what was not retrieved. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Full correct lineage and identifiers supported by bundle. States the family 100905 'not a true family' annotation, notes class-k homology warning (supported by /sunids/58788/homology), and explains the annotation overrides the usual same-family homology rule. Well calibrated: also notes the caveat does not prove non-relatedness and lists needed external evidence; rejects function/ligand transfer.

Complete: 1.69 c.137.1.1 own fold vs c.23.14.1; move to c.23.14.2 under 52309 already in 1.71 (bundle-supported via 1.71 parents); 2.08 d1t1ja1/d1t1jb1 (1-118) c.23.14.2 vs d1f8ya_ c.23.14.1; superfamily rename; tag artifact domains with l.1.1.1 lineage; retired c.137 nodes. Evolutionary interpretation correct (probable common ancestry at superfamily, not close homology; 1.69 different fold was absence of claim, not evidence of non-relation). Limits on function/template transfer and unverified paper rationale. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Complete: correct artifact lineage with sunids, correct d1a14h1 H:9-111 b.1.1.1 lineage, homology endpoint (homology_implied_by_level=false, artifact_not_homology_evidence) cited accurately. Explains class l levels as bookkeeping, rejects transfer of family/function/template via tag, limits homology inference to d1a14h1 and notes antigen specificity is not transferable. States what was not confirmed. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1; 2026-10-14.

Complete release-by-release support with sunids at every level for both the retired 1.75 lineage and the current two-domain parse (d1acca2 A:14-225 b.179.1.1; d1acca1 A:226-735 f.60.1.1), including retirement of f.11 and the current-release metadata. Infers that the chain, not the domain, was the wrong unit and that a chain-level label hid a widespread module; keeps superfamily ancestry separate from function, declines to call the two halves unrelated, and marks the mapping of SCOPe ranges onto literature PA domains as unverified. Search advice is per-domain, coverage-checked, release-remapped, and explicitly blocks ligand, pore-forming and receptor-binding transfer.

Complete and bundle-verified: five domains with sids, boundaries, sccs, sunids; d.394 fold/sf/fa singletons; a.29.2.1 is the existing Bromodomain family; family 159638 flagged as likely predating 2.08 with honest unverified caveat. Mosaic reading distinguishes inherited nucleic-acid-enzyme modules from lineage-specific N-terminal domain, homology-is-not-function, new fold does not prove no homologs, coverage gaps (1-46, 1781-1783, Jab1/MPN). No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-14.

Complete: shared family a.298.1.1 for all three, length explained by repeat copy number plus terminal segments, and explicit use of the 're' heterogeneity/inconsistency flag on d2kq5a_ and d3v6pa_ with its definition, the canonical repeat unit 4cj9 A:259-292 with d4cj9a_ as representative, and correct reading of coordinates_apply_to_requested_node. States limits well: global identity/coverage/RMSD invalid across repeat arrays, no DNA-target transfer, d2kq5a_ unsuitable as template, no ASTRAL quality retrieved, repeat counts flagged as its own estimate. Release, lineage, lengths and comments ('single repeat', 'complexed with se') all match evidence. Evaluator: Claude SCOPe benchmark grader, 2026-10-14.

All metadata correct and bundle-supported (2.08, 2.08-stable, dates, flags, periodic 2.08-2026-08-16, api_url). Cites stable 2.08 with release selector, rejects floating 'current', preserves exact periodic label if used. Explains periodic update as dated incremental layer adding newly deposited PDB entries via automated matching without full re-curation, not a new stable version. Clearly separates background knowledge from API-stated facts and states limits. Complete.

Thorough and bundle-backed: shared a.47.2.1 lineage; fragment comment and 'ms' flag; d1dn1b_ history (curated 17771 in 1.55/1.75, no domains in 2.01/2.03/2.05, automated match 302344 to curated d3c98b_ from 2.06); four-long-helix fold definition versus three-helix fragments resembling a spectrin repeat, so the fragments' a.47 placement is inherited from the full protein. Correctly separates family-level homology from fold similarity, treats the spectrin note as structural only, forbids function transfer in either direction, prefers complete domains as templates, and flags unretrieved quality records and unverified obsolescence cause. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Makes the full inference: divergence within c.2.1, probable independent origins across folds and classes (c.2 vs d.58.20 HMG-CoA reductase NAD domain), and explicitly states that separate superfamily placement is not proof of convergence while listing the independent evidence needed. Possible deep c.2/c.3/c.4 homology acknowledged as unresolved. Evidence-integration criteria complete. All cited nodes (c.31.1/CobB 102292, d.58.20 55035 in fold d.58, e.52.1 111331, d.81.1, c.23.12) and release labels are supported by the bundle; general-knowledge statements are clearly labelled as unverified. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Accurate and fully evidenced. Gives 2.04 lineages for both domains including the retired superfamily b.23.2 and its calcium-free-form comment, localizes the move to 2.05 by checking each release, and reports 2.08 shared superfamily b.18.1 with families b.18.1.36 and b.18.1.3 distinct, plus sunid stability and the chain B split treated correctly as boundary bookkeeping rather than a homology change. Quotes the family comment and resolves d1w99a3 to b.18.1.3 and d2quoa_ to b.18.1.37, and notes neither 1w99 nor 2quo existed in 2.04, which supports a later structure-based regrouping. Explicitly states the 2.04 separation was a lack of claim, that the superfamily implies probable ancestry only, that shared target-binding roles are supporting not probative, and that the empty homology-warning response is not positive evidence. Blocks ligand, Ca, receptor and template transfer. Evaluator: Claude, 2026-10-14.

Correct release labels, lineage, sunids, boundaries, comments, hf definition and homology flags. Explains that hf is a structural caveat, fold label describes the exemplar, and homology holds by sequence and shared gene. Rejects templates in both directions, covers label contamination, leakage, stratification and representative choice, declines function/geometry transfer, and refrains from a quality ranking since none was retrieved. L16A/NMR identity flagged as pretrained knowledge.

Complete: family-level common ancestry retained, fr flag found in both annotation and homology-heterogeneity records with 50/99 residues observed, alignment with explicit gaps and coverage normalised to complete partner, SPACI/AEROSPACI entry-level so completeness filtered first, d1uc6a1 the complete choice, fragment excluded or analysed separately with flag kept, tissue-factor sequence still counts as lineage. States limits (no superposition run, no whole-family ranking). All values match bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-14.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-14. Complete reasoning: family/superfamily carry homology claims, fold/class do not; new superfamily = no homology claim, explicitly not proof of non-homology; new fold = different core structure; revisable hypothesis with listed evidence types; single FATCAT/BLAST hit is not a SCOPe assignment. c.1 example (sunid 51350, named superfamilies c.1.1, c.1.8, c.1.28) and release metadata supported by bundle; c.1.34 and count of 34 fall just past the truncated body but are consistent with the full response (has_more false).

Correct identifiers, release dates, fold annotation, homology record and family membership (ThrB, MtnK, mTOR, Ire1) all bundle-supported. States probable common ancestry at superfamily level, distant homology between families, shared mechanism as hypothesis to verify, and refuses transfer of substrate, regulation, activity, and inhibitor sensitivity. Evidence list includes inspected structural alignment, specificity-residue conservation, family/phylogenetic relationship, domain architecture, ligand-bound structures, and experiments.
